beliefs: Only the first character of the string is shifted backward by one in the alphabet (a->z, b->a, ..., z->y) [E1, E2, E3, E4, E5]
All characters after the first are left unchanged [E5]
Uppercase first letters are shifted backward too (A->Z, B->A, ..., Z->Y) [E1, E2, E3, E4]
If the first character is not a letter (digit, symbol, space), the string is unchanged [E1]
notes: E5 shows only the first character shifts; the rest are untouched. So the rule is a single backward Caesar shift on the first character if it's a letter.
